mapper.select: /* recipe.selectRecipeCount */ SELECT count(RECIPE_IDX) as cnt FROM lab_recipe WHERE 1 = 1 AND DOC_OWNER = #{userId} AND IS_DELETE = 'N' AND IS_LAST = 'Y'

/* recipe.selectRecipeList */ SELECT lr.* , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('PLANT ', lr.PLANT) AS PLANT_TXT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('DOC_STATUS', lr.STATUS) AS STATUS_TXT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lab_recipe WHERE 1 = 1 AND PRODUCT_CODE = lr.PRODUCT_CODE AND IS_LAST = 'N' AND VERSION_NO < lr.VERSION_NO AND IS_DELETE = 'N' ) as CHILD_CNT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UNIT', lr.PRODUCT_UNIT) AS UNIT_NAME , FN_GET_USER_NAME(lr.DOC_OWNER) as USER_NAME FROM lab_recipe lr WHERE 1 = 1 AND DOC_NO in ( SELECT tmp.DOC_NO FROM ( SELECT row_number() over (order by RECIPE_IDX DESC) as rnum , DOC_NO FROM lab_recipe WHERE 1 = 1 AND DOC_OWNER = #{userId} AND IS_DELETE = 'N' AND IS_LAST = 'Y'
) tmp WHERE rnum between #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ) ORDER BY DOC_NO DESC, VERSION_NO DESC, RECIPE_IDX DESC
mapper.insert:
/* recipe.insertRecipeMaterial */ INSERT INTO lab_recipe_material( RECIPE_IDX , SAP_CODE , ITEM_NAME , ITEM_NO , ITEM_COUNT , ITEM_UNIT , USED_COUNT , USED_UNIT )values
( #{item.idx}, #{item.sapCode}, #{item.productName}, #{item.no}, #{item.compCount}, #{item.compUnit}, #{item.useCount}, #{item.useUnit} )

/* recipe.insertRecipePurchase */ INSERT INTO lab_recipe_purchase( RECIPE_IDX , PURCHASE_NO , ITEM_NAME , ITEM_COUNT , ITEM_UNIT , USED_COUNT , USED_UNIT )values
( #{item.idx}, #{item.no}, #{item.name}, #{item.compCount}, #{item.compUnit}, #{item.useCount}, #{item.useUnit} )
mapper.select: /* recipe.selectRecipeData */ SELECT RECIPE_IDX , PRODUCT_CODE , PRODUCT_NAME , PLANT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('PLANT', PLANT) AS PLANT_NAME , PRODUCT_COUNT , PRODUCT_UNIT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UNIT', PRODUCT_UNIT) AS UNIT_NAME , DOC_NO , VERSION_NO , IS_DELETE , IS_LAST , REG_USER , DOC_OWNER , STATUS FROM lab_recipe WHERE 1 = 1 AND RECIPE_IDX = #{idx}

/* recipe.selectMaterialList */ SELECT RECIPE_IDX , SAP_CODE , ITEM_NAME , ITEM_NO , ITEM_COUNT , ITEM_UNIT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UNIT', ITEM_UNIT) AS ITEM_UNIT_NAME , USED_COUNT , USED_UNIT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UNIT', USED_UNIT) AS USED_UNIT_NAME FROM lab_recipe_material WHERE 1 = 1 AND RECIPE_IDX = #{idx} ORDER BY ITEM_NO ASC

/* recipe.selectPurchaseList */ SELECT RECIPE_IDX , ITEM_NAME , ITEM_COUNT , ITEM_UNIT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UNIT', ITEM_UNIT) AS ITEM_UNIT_NAME , USED_COUNT , USED_UNIT , FN_GET_CODE_NAME('UNIT', USED_UNIT) AS USED_UNIT_NAME , PURCHASE_NO FROM lab_recipe_purchase WHERE 1 = 1 AND RECIPE_IDX = #{idx} ORDER BY PURCHASE_NO ASC

/* recipe.selectHistory */ SELECT lh.DOC_IDX , lh.HISTORY_TYPE , CASE WHEN lh.HISTORY_TYPE = 'I' then '등록' WHEN lh.HISTORY_TYPE = 'V' then '개정' WHEN lh.HISTORY_TYPE = 'D' then '삭제' WHEN lh.HISTORY_TYPE = 'U' then '수정' WHEN lh.HISTORY_TYPE = 'T' then '임시저장' END HISTORY_TYPE_TXT , lr.VERSION_NO , lr.PRODUCT_NAME , lr.PRODUCT_CODE , lh.USER_ID , FN_GET_USER_NAME(lh.USER_ID) as USER_NAME , DATE_FORMAT(lh.REG_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as REG_DATE FROM lab_history lh , lab_recipe lr WHERE 1 = 1 AND lh.DOC_IDX IN (SELECT RECIPE_IDX FROM lab_recipe WHERE 1 = 1 AND DOC_NO = #{docNo}) AND lh.DOC_TYPE = #{docType} AND lh.DOC_IDX = lr.RECIPE_IDX ORDER BY lh.REG_DATE ASC
